data.body: Reassessed against current origin/main 51da20e753 (2026-08-10): partially resolved, not complete. ab0e7f577f removed rebar's own use of the repository-wide stash stack; ade954fcd3 repaired stranded-index handling; 19341e2edb improved foreign-path reporting; and 51da20e753 added the supported tracker-maintenance path and bans stash inside the tracker. The broader agent hazard remains: canonical worktree guidance still does not plainly warn that source-worktree stashes share one repository-wide stack, and there is no general mechanical guard preventing agents from using it. Keep this ticket open for that remaining scope.
